title: New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders
summary: Bitcoin Magazine New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders A New York judge ordered NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion to pay more than $1.37 billion over a crypto Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian communities. This post New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
